{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, ensures ideas are captured promptly, and provides a structured way to evaluate and prioritize them.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier.
- **Title** – Short descriptive name.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation.
- **Originator** – Who suggested the idea.
- **Date Added** – When the idea was recorded.
- **Status** – New / In Review / Approved / Rejected / Implemented.
- **Priority** – Low / Medium / High.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or follow‑up actions.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file.
2. Append a new section following the template below.
3. Save and share with the team.

---

## Example Entry

### Idea ID: 001
- **Title:** AI‑Powered Knowledge Base
- **Description:** Implement a chatbot that pulls from our internal documentation to answer employee queries.
- **Originator:** Jane Doe
- **Date Added:** 2026‑05‑30
- **Status:** New
- **Priority:** High
- **Notes:** Needs feasibility study.

---

Feel free to adapt the template as needed.
", "file_name": "FreshIdeasTracker.md"}

{"file_content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, ensures ideas are captured promptly, and provides a structured way to evaluate and prioritize them.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier.
- **Title** – Short descriptive name.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation.
- **Originator** – Who suggested the idea.
- **Date Added** – When the idea was recorded.
- **Status** – New / In Review / Approved / Rejected / Implemented.
- **Priority** – Low / Medium / High.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or follow‑up actions.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file.
2. Append a new section following the template below.
3. Save and share with the team.

---

## Example Entry

### Idea ID: 001
- **Title:** AI‑Powered Knowledge Base
- **Description:** Implement a chatbot that pulls from our internal documentation to answer employee queries.
- **Originator:** Jane Doe
- **Date Added:** 2026‑05‑30
- **Status:** New
- **Priority:** High
- **Notes:** Needs feasibility study.

---

Feel free to adapt the template as needed.
"}

- **Date Added** – When the idea was recorded.

1. Open this file.

- **Originator:** Jane Doe
- **Date Added:** 2026‑05‑30
- **Status:** New
- **Priority:** High
- **Notes:** Needs feasibility study.

---

Feel free to adapt the template as needed.
"}

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, ensures ideas are captured promptly, and provides a structured way to evaluate and prioritize them.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier.
- **Title** – Short descriptive name.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation.
- **Originator** – Who suggested the idea.
- **Date Added** – When the idea was recorded.
- **Status** – New / In Review / Approved / Rejected / Implemented.
- **Priority** – Low / Medium / High.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or follow‑up actions.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file.
2. Append a new section following the template below.
3. Save and share with the team.

---

## Example Entry

### Idea ID: 001
- **Title:** AI‑Powered Knowledge Base
- **Description:** Implement a chatbot that pulls from our internal documentation to answer employee queries.
- **Originator:** Jane Doe
- **Date Added:** 2026‑05‑30
- **Status:** New
- **Priority:** High
- **Notes:** Needs feasibility study.

---

Feel free to adapt the template as needed.
"}

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It encourages collaboration, ensures ideas are captured promptly, and provides a structured way to evaluate and prioritize them.

## Structure
- **Idea ID** – Unique identifier.
- **Title** – Short descriptive name.
- **Description** – Detailed explanation.
- **Originator** – Who suggested the idea.
- **Date Added** – When the idea was recorded.
- **Status** – New / In Review / Approved / Rejected / Implemented.
- **Priority** – Low / Medium / High.
- **Notes** – Additional comments or follow‑up actions.

1. Open this file.

---

- **Originator:** Jane Doe
- **Date Added:** 2026‑05‑30
- **Status:** New
- **Priority:** High
- **Notes:** Needs feasibility study.

---

Feel free to adapt the template as needed.
"}

- **Status:** New
- **Priority:** High

---

Feel free to adapt the template as needed.
"}
